summary: Frontend-only testing for NexaEdit editor round 4 (double-tap rename, close-tab confirmation, reopen, zoom slider/segmented, AI check scope, status bar updates). All 7 flows passed. Double-tap on active tab opens editor-rename-sheet and renames file (header updated to sample2.js). Close-tab flow: close icon opens close-tab-sheet; close-tab-cancel keeps tab; close-tab-confirm removes it; more-reopen reopens the closed tab. close-tab-dont-ask closes without further prompt (confirmed next close had no sheet). Settings toggle-confirmCloseTab exists and re-enables prompt. Zoom: status-bar zoom-slider renders at 100%; settings zoom-1.25 updates editor zoom-value to 125%; zoom-reset-btn returns to 100%. Font size visibly changes. Check screen: open-check-btn opens the screen; check-tab-ai switch shows ai-scope with 'Only analyzing the open tab “sample.js” · 58 words'; run-ai-btn ran real LLM in ~15s returning ai-score=58 with bug/clarity/style suggestions. Status bar: cursor-position, word-count, char-count, line-count update on typing; undo-btn reverted chars from 398 → 393. No crashes, no red screens.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from a Sheet/overlay component. Non-blocking but should migrate to style.pointerEvents. Reference: shows in RichEditor/Sheet mounts.

action_items: Optional: migrate deprecated prop pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence console warnings (cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: editor.tsx scrollToOffset uses `void line; setTimeout focus` as placeholder — goto-sheet jumps caret via selection but no explicit scroll; works because the TextInput native cursor-follow handles it on focus. Fine for now.
requestClose(id) correctly bypasses sheet when settings.confirmCloseTab === false; also handles non-active tab close path.
Double-tap detection uses 350ms window and resets lastTap on success — reliable in testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-4 editor requests validated via mobile viewport 390x844 against EXPO_BACKEND_URL. AI coach is live and returns real responses in ~15s. Pinch zoom is only available on native (gesture skipped on web as noted).
